name: Corona Layers
desc: One interlocking tile, ringed by its own coronas out to the frame edge — the shape writhes and re-carves its own silhouette continuously yet every neighbour still locks in without a hair of gap, while rings of state change ripple outward layer by layer under an orbiting light.

energy.doc: interlock violence + shading contrast + joint weight

scale.doc: tile size vs frame (2 = a few colossal interlocking cells)

density.doc: inlaid inner contours cut into each cell

wig.doc: how far the tile edges depart from a plain hexagon (0 = regular hexagons, 1 = deep Escher interlock)

rings.doc: strength of the corona wave rippling outward through the layers

x.doc: core cell x as canvas fraction

y.doc: core cell y as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: engraved marquetry inlay in dark shellac / two-ink risograph overprint / verdigris patina on bronze / cold incised slate / luminous additive contours on black (non-representational)

seed.doc: the tile's edge harmonics — reseeds the whole interlocking shape
